text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aughhh! How laaaaame!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The dust has cleared at Oka Sho, and
Vodka's
regretful cries at failing to beat
Daiwa Scarlet
echo through the blue sky
above us.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Lame! Lame! Laaaaame!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Not winning is lame too, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
More than anything, the lamest thing is
how
relieved I feel.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The Classics are crazy... That feeling in
your chest
after you finish runnin'...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After her first race in the Classics, Vodka
seems
to be feeling rather emotional.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Good race, Vodka. Now then, have you
realized
my true skill?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I admit you've gotten strong too. Still no
better
than number two, though.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Why you little... Don't get too carried
away!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And don't you forget! The Classics are
only just
gettin' started!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait till next time! I'll show you! I'm
gonna take
you down!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, I can't wait. ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
After all, my excellence only stands out
even
more with you chasing me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait. See you at the Japanese
Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You'd better not chicken out!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I couldn't win, Trainer, and for also
for
gettin' too heated.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The Derby?
choice_data_list_en: What do you want to do about the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka and her rival have a heated
competition.
But it can't continue
unconditionally...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I dunno what I should do.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I can't just give in after she's just beaten
me. Of
course I wanna make up for the
loss.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
More than that, I wanna run against her
again!
She showed some real strength
today.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But... I have another dream that I can't
give up
on, either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's rivalry with Daiwa Scarlet will
only get
more complicated after the Oka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Run in the Derby or run against her rival.
This
time, choosing both is not an
option.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If it's just for now, keep me on for the
Derby.
But...
choice_data_list: 次のレース……とりあえず、どうする？
choice_data_list_en: The next race... what should we do for now?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I gotta think for a bit. Actually, would ya
mind
thinkin' about it with me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's expression grows dark and
heavy.
